usedFor: Shopify takes the orders, and Featurebase collects feedback through “Create Feedback Post”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create Feedback Post” in Featurebase
bestTemplate.why: Each cancellation lands as a feedback post, so the team can review it in one place.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so its feedback post appears after a scheduled check.
